description: FDTD Transmission Line Simulator. Runs server-side on rftools.io as an async job. Free lane: solveMode cannot be normal or fine without a paid key. Time budget 32400 s. Returns a summarised result; ask for full for everything. Cross-parameter checks: sweep_span_within_center.

copperT.description: Copper Thickness (mm). 0.035 mm is 1 oz copper. min 0.005, max 0.5. omit for the default of 0.035. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

freqCenter.description: Center Frequency (Hz). min 100000000. omit for the default of 2400000000

freqSpan.description: Frequency Span (Hz). min 100000000. omit for the default of 4000000000

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

gapW.description: Coupling Gap (mm). min 0.05, max 5. omit for the default of 0.2. Applies when structureType is "coupled_line_filter".

roughness.description: Surface Roughness (µm). RMS copper roughness used by the Hammerstad/Huray correction. min 0, max 10. omit for the default of 0.6. Advanced — most callers can leave it out

solveMode.description: Solve Mode. Instant solves a 2D cross-section and cascades published models — seconds, engineering accuracy. Express and above run a real 3D FDTD field solve on progressively finer meshes. omit for the default of "instant". Paid tier only: normal, fine.

structureType.description: Structure. omit for the default of "microstrip_open_stub"

stubL.description: Stub Length (mm). min 1, max 100. omit for the default of 15. Applies when structureType is "microstrip_open_stub".

subEr.description: Dielectric Constant. min 1, max 20. omit for the default of 4.4. Applies when substrateName is "custom".

subH.description: Substrate Height (mm). min 0.1, max 10. omit for the default of 1.6. Applies when substrateName is "custom".

subTanD.description: Loss Tangent. min 0, max 0.1. omit for the default of 0.02. Applies when substrateName is "custom".

substrateName.description: Substrate. omit for the default of "FR4"

traceL.description: Trace Length (mm). min 1, max 200. omit for the default of 30

traceW.description: Trace Width (mm). min 0.1, max 20. omit for the default of 3

viaAR.description: Via Aspect Ratio. min 1, max 20. omit for the default of 5. Applies when structureType is "through_via".

viaDia.description: Via Diameter (mm). min 0.1, max 2. omit for the default of 0.3. Applies when structureType is "through_via".

w2.description: Output Trace Width (mm). min 0.1, max 20. omit for the default of 1.5. Applies when structureType is "step_discontinuity".

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_fdtd_sparam
title: FDTD Transmission Line Simulator
